name: agent_review
description: Record the agent's own explanation of one grouped tool issue in the shared review log. Administrator only. One note per issue group: a later note for the same group replaces the earlier one
retry_hint: a repeated note for the same group replaces the earlier one, so a retry is harmless

tool.description: The issue group's tool name, exactly as reported

class.description: The issue group's class: error, denied, uncertain or warning

kind.description: The issue group's error kind, exactly as reported

template.description: The issue group's message template, exactly as reported

note.description: What you were trying to do, what you expected, and what would have prevented the issue, written so someone can fix the cause without reading this conversation
